title: feat: applications page pipeline redesign with unified contacts, reminders, and status notes
body:
## What

Full Applications page upgrade — the layout locked in the design grill (pipeline strip + list), plus the data-model work it surfaced.

**UI**
- Pipeline strip: 6 glass stat cards (Saved · Applied · Screening · Interviewing · Offer · Closed) — click = filter; Closed aggregates rejected/ghosted/withdrawn with per-row stage tags when filtered; overdue follow-up badge on the strip.
- Richer rows: date, board chip, doc count, next-action/overdue tag; sort control; flat list under any active filter (`activeStages !== null`), stage-sectioned when unfiltered.
- Interaction log: `setStatus({note})` finally has UI — optional note on stage change (`StatusNoteModal`) + "Add note" writing a same-status event; timeline interleaves notes.
- Detail panel: contact card, promoted reminder field, timeline with notes.
- Skeletons share the strip's real class constants — 0.0px layout shift at all three text scales.

**Data/backend**
- Contact unification migration: `recipientName/Email` + `contactName/Email` merged into one canonical contact pair (backfill prefers `contact*`); ApplyByEmailTab and Overview read/write the same fields.
- Reminders: due/overdue `nextActionAt` posts to the notification center with the existing `/applications?highlight=` deep link; checked on app start + periodic timer.

**A11y/design-system hardening that fell out of review**
- `use-focus-trap`: pre-open element captured in a layout effect; `autoFocus` removed from dialog content (it defeats return-focus — React applies it during commit, before any effect); pinned by tests including a real-trigger Escape→restore path.
- Light-scheme contrast: canonical `utilities.css` light block remapped (`text-red-400` → red-700, `text-amber-400` → amber-800, `text-brand-soft` → canonical brand) — all audited readings now ≥4.5:1; probe asserts exactly one light rule per class so silent shadowing can't recur.
- State styling on `.surface-card` descendants via `ring-*` (the unlayered utilities layer makes `bg-*`/`border-*` state dead); real `_one`/`_other` plurals in both locales.

## Review trail

Author → `frontend-reviewer` → `ui-ux-expert` (3 rounds, empirical: headless-Chromium measurements at 900×600/1440×900, dark+light, three text scales, pixel diffs) → final re-verify: **APPROVE — PR-ready**. Focus-restore, contrast, dedup-headers, skeleton-shift all measured fixed; advisory LOW (German label truncation at large scale) fixed via `title` attr in `b5a46562`.

## Verification

`pnpm format:check` 0 · `lint:strict` 0 · `typecheck` 13/13 · `pnpm test` 391 files / 4417 tests · `cargo fmt --check` 0 · clippy `--all-targets --all-features --locked -D warnings` 0 · `cargo test --locked` 2832 passed / 26 ignored · paint probes 13/13 + 17/17 — all re-run on the merged tree (zero-conflict merge with `origin/main` through #895, overlapping files verified semantically).

## Notes

- Migration bumps the dev DB; devs on old dev DBs may need to delete it (see docs note in the close-out PR).
- Accepted follow-ups (tracked in the follow-ups ledger): narrow-width row density `@container` mitigation, company-avatar light contrast bump, ADR-0001 "grouped list" supersession note.
- Branch is 1 generated-file commit behind main (`chore: update export benchmark data [skip ci]`) — zero overlap.
